questions.text: Which flightless bird is famous for waddling across Antarctic ice?
questions.explanation: Penguins live in the Southern Hemisphere, with several species in Antarctica.

questions.text: Which insect is the busy maker of honey?
questions.explanation: Honey bees turn nectar into honey.

questions.text: What is a baby kangaroo called?
questions.explanation: A baby kangaroo is a joey.

questions.text: Which is the largest living land animal?
questions.explanation: The African bush elephant is the largest land animal alive.

questions.text: How many legs does a spider have?
questions.explanation: Spiders are arachnids with eight legs.

questions.text: Which is the fastest land animal over a short sprint?
questions.explanation: Cheetahs can reach roughly 100 km/h in short bursts.

questions.text: Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Pacific covers about a third of the planet's surface.

questions.text: Which is the only mammal capable of true, sustained flight?
questions.explanation: Other gliding mammals only glide; bats actually fly.

questions.text: What does the giant panda mainly eat?
questions.explanation: Bamboo makes up most of a giant panda's diet.

questions.text: Which gas do plants take in for photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Plants use carbon dioxide, water and light to make sugars.

questions.text: Which is the largest fish in the world?
questions.explanation: The whale shark is the largest living fish.

questions.text: What is a group of crows traditionally called?
questions.explanation: "A murder of crows" is the traditional collective noun.

questions.text: Which living bird lays the largest egg?
questions.explanation: An ostrich egg can weigh over 1.4 kg.

questions.text: Which of these mammals lays eggs?
questions.explanation: The platypus and the echidnas are monotremes.

spares.text: Which animal is nicknamed the "ship of the desert"?
spares.explanation: Camels carry people and goods across deserts.

spares.text: Which big cat lives in groups called prides?
spares.explanation: Lions are the only truly social big cats.

spares.text: How many hearts does an octopus have?
spares.explanation: Two branchial hearts and one systemic heart.
